title: Creating Studio Redirects to Demo Studio
description: Bug: when creating a studio it redirects to demo studio instead of creating/opening a new one. createStudio correctly creates a catalog entry and navigates to /studios/{id}, but the studio app always boots from demo_studio_projection(), openStudio never loads the catalog document, and boot setActiveExample("demo") can override the URL to /studios/demo.
summary: Implemented ephemeral studio create-and-open: `create_ephemeral_os_studio` in os-core mints empty docs with `backbone: None` and no port write. Default/temporary `createStudio` registers in `EPHEMERAL_STUDIOS` and emits Navigate only (no download, no catalog backbone). `resolve_studio_document` checks ephemeral first; `openStudio` loads ephemeral/catalog docs, uses demo fixture only for explicit `studioId: demo`, otherwise mints empty doc on miss. Extended unit tests and rebuilt s WASM.
